hooandee/panel-de-control.name: panel-de-control: v0.81.2
hooandee/panel-de-control.body:
### Novedades

- **Radio más fiable:** Si el servicio de emisoras falla, Ambiente ya no te dice que no hay resultados. Lo vuelve a intentar solo y, si sigue sin responder, te deja un botón para reintentar sin perder tus filtros. Además ahora suenan más emisoras.
- **Mapa de emisoras con el mando:** Entras al mapa con A y sales con B, y moverte entre el mapa y los filtros funciona como esperas.

### What's new

- **More reliable radio:** If the station service fails, Ambient no longer tells you there are no results. It tries again on its own and, if it still doesn't answer, gives you a button to retry without losing your filters. More stations play now too.
- **Station map with the controller:** Press A to enter the map and B to leave it, and moving between the map and the filters works as you'd expect.

### Novità

- **Radio più affidabile:** Se il servizio delle stazioni non risponde, Atmosfera non ti dice più che non ci sono risultati. Riprova da sola e, se ancora non risponde, ti lascia un pulsante per riprovare senza perdere i filtri. Inoltre ora si possono ascoltare più stazioni.
- **Mappa delle stazioni con il controller:** Entri nella mappa con A ed esci con B, e spostarti tra la mappa e i filtri funziona come ti aspetti.

### Neuigkeiten

- **Zuverlässigeres Radio:** Wenn der Senderdienst ausfällt, zeigt Ambiente nicht mehr „keine Ergebnisse“ an. Es versucht es selbst noch einmal und bietet dir, falls weiterhin keine Antwort kommt, eine Schaltfläche zum erneuten Versuchen, ohne deine Filter zu verlieren. Außerdem laufen jetzt mehr Sender.
- **Senderkarte mit dem Controller:** Mit A gehst du in die Karte, mit B wieder heraus, und der Wechsel zwischen Karte und Filtern funktioniert wie erwartet.

### Novidades em português (Brasil)

- **Rádio mais confiável:** Se o serviço de estações falhar, o Ambiente não diz mais que não há resultados. Ele tenta de novo sozinho e, se continuar sem resposta, mostra um botão para tentar outra vez sem perder seus filtros. Além disso, agora tocam mais estações.
- **Mapa de estações no controle:** Você entra no mapa com A e sai com B, e passar do mapa para os filtros funciona como esperado.

### Nouveautés

- **Radio plus fiable :** Si le service des stations ne répond pas, Ambiance ne vous dit plus qu'il n'y a aucun résultat. Il réessaie tout seul et, s'il ne répond toujours pas, vous propose un bouton pour réessayer sans perdre vos filtres. Davantage de stations fonctionnent aussi.
- **Carte des stations à la manette :** Vous entrez dans la carte avec A et en sortez avec B, et passer de la carte aux filtres fonctionne comme prévu.

hooandee/panel-de-control.name: panel-de-control: v0.81.1
hooandee/panel-de-control.body:
### Novedades

- **La biblioteca de Ambiente ya no se encoge:** Al abrir la biblioteca de fotos, la ventana podía hacerse pequeña sola hasta desaparecer. Ahora se abre a su tamaño y se queda así.

### What's new

- **The Ambient library no longer shrinks:** Opening the photo library could make the window shrink by itself until it disappeared. It now opens at full size and stays that way.

### Novità

- **La libreria di Atmosfera non si rimpicciolisce più:** Aprendo la libreria delle foto, la finestra poteva rimpicciolirsi da sola fino a sparire. Ora si apre a dimensione piena e resta così.

### Neuigkeiten

- **Die Ambiente-Bibliothek schrumpft nicht mehr:** Beim Öffnen der Fotobibliothek konnte das Fenster von selbst immer kleiner werden, bis es verschwand. Jetzt öffnet es sich in voller Größe und bleibt so.

### Novidades em português (Brasil)

- **A biblioteca do Ambiente não encolhe mais:** Ao abrir a biblioteca de fotos, a janela podia encolher sozinha até sumir. Agora ela abre no tamanho certo e continua assim.

### Nouveautés

- **La bibliothèque d'Ambiance ne rétrécit plus :** En ouvrant la bibliothèque de photos, la fenêtre pouvait rétrécir toute seule jusqu'à disparaître. Elle s'ouvre maintenant en taille normale et le reste.

hooandee/panel-de-control.name: panel-de-control: v0.81.0
hooandee/panel-de-control.body:
### Novedades

- **Nueva sección Ambiente:** Pon tus fotos, tus vídeos o el arte de tus juegos de fondo en Inicio. Viene apagada, así que Steam se queda como siempre hasta que la actives.
- **Música y radio mientras juegas:** Escucha tu música, radios de todo el mundo, YouTube o Twitch con un mini reproductor que sigue sonando en partida y se maneja con el mando.
- **Cola de reproducción:** Añade canciones, carpetas, emisoras y enlaces, ordénalos a tu gusto y elige repetir o aleatorio. La cola se guarda aunque reinicies.
- **Enlaces desde el móvil:** Escanea un código QR con el móvil, pega los enlaces que quieras y entran directos en la cola.
- **Temas y fondo, sin pelearse:** Los temas compatibles pueden mostrar tu fondo o quedarse con el suyo. Si hay conflicto, Panel te pregunta una sola vez.

### What's new

- **New Ambient section:** Use your photos, your videos or your games' art as the Home background. It starts off, so Steam stays as it is until you turn it on.
- **Music and radio while you play:** Listen to your music, radio from around the world, YouTube or Twitch with a mini player that keeps playing in game and works with the controller.
- **Play queue:** Add songs, folders, stations and links, put them in any order and choose repeat or shuffle. The queue is kept after a restart.
- **Links from your phone:** Scan a QR code with your phone, paste as many links as you like and they go straight into the queue.
- **Themes and background get along:** Compatible themes can show your background or keep their own. If they clash, Panel asks you just once.

### Novità

- **Nuova sezione Atmosfera:** Usa le tue foto, i tuoi video o le immagini dei tuoi giochi come sfondo della Home. Parte disattivata, quindi Steam resta com'è finché non la attivi.
- **Musica e radio mentre giochi:** Ascolta la tua musica, radio da tutto il mondo, YouTube o Twitch con un mini lettore che continua a suonare in partita e si usa con il controller.
- **Coda di riproduzione:** Aggiungi brani, cartelle, stazioni e link, mettili nell'ordine che vuoi e scegli ripetizione o casuale. La coda resta anche dopo un riavvio.
- **Link dal telefono:** Inquadra un codice QR con il telefono, incolla tutti i link che vuoi e finiscono subito in coda.
- **Temi e sfondo vanno d'accordo:** I temi compatibili possono mostrare il tuo sfondo o tenere il loro. Se c'è un conflitto, Panel te lo chiede una sola volta.

### Neuigkeiten

- **Neuer Bereich Ambiente:** Nutze deine Fotos, Videos oder die Bilder deiner Spiele als Hintergrund der Startseite. Er ist anfangs aus, Steam bleibt also unverändert, bis du ihn einschaltest.
- **Musik und Radio beim Spielen:** Hör deine Musik, Radio aus aller Welt, YouTube oder Twitch mit einem Mini-Player, der im Spiel weiterläuft und sich mit dem Controller bedienen lässt.
- **Warteschlange:** Füge Songs, Ordner, Sender und Links hinzu, ordne sie, wie du willst, und wähle Wiederholen oder Zufall. Die Warteschlange bleibt auch nach einem Neustart erhalten.
- **Links vom Handy:** Scanne einen QR-Code mit dem Handy, füge so viele Links ein, wie du willst, und sie landen direkt in der Warteschlange.
- **Themes und Hintergrund vertragen sich:** Kompatible Themes können deinen Hintergrund zeigen oder ihren eigenen behalten. Gibt es einen Konflikt, fragt Panel dich nur einmal.

### Novidades em português (Brasil)

- **Nova seção Ambiente:** Use suas fotos, seus vídeos ou a arte dos seus jogos como fundo do Início. Ela vem desligada, então o Steam continua como sempre até você ativar.
- **Música e rádio enquanto você joga:** Ouça suas músicas, rádios do mundo todo, YouTube ou Twitch com um mini player que continua tocando no jogo e funciona com o controle.
- **Fila de reprodução:** Adicione músicas, pastas, estações e links, organize do seu jeito e escolha repetir ou aleatório. A fila fica salva mesmo depois de reiniciar.
- **Links pelo celular:** Escaneie um código QR com o celular, cole quantos links quiser e eles vão direto para a fila.
- **Temas e fundo sem briga:** Temas compatíveis podem mostrar o seu fundo ou manter o deles. Se houver conflito, o Panel pergunta uma única vez.

### Nouveautés

- **Nouvelle section Ambiance :** Mettez vos photos, vos vidéos ou les images de vos jeux en fond de l'Accueil. Elle est désactivée au départ, donc Steam reste tel quel tant que vous ne l'activez pas.
- **Musique et radio pendant vos parties :** Écoutez votre musique, des radios du monde entier, YouTube ou Twitch avec un mini-lecteur qui continue en jeu et se pilote à la manette.
- **File de lecture :** Ajoutez morceaux, dossiers, stations et liens, rangez-les comme vous voulez et choisissez répétition ou aléatoire. La file est conservée après un redémarrage.
- **Liens depuis le téléphone :** Scannez un code QR avec votre téléphone, collez autant de liens que vous voulez et ils arrivent directement dans la file.
- **Thèmes et fond s'entendent :** Les thèmes compatibles peuvent afficher votre fond ou garder le leur. En cas de conflit, Panel vous pose la question une seule fois.

hooandee/panel-de-control.name: panel-de-control: v0.80.3
hooandee/panel-de-control.body:
### Novedades

- **Steam ya no se cae en la beta:** Con el cliente beta de Steam, Panel podía tumbar toda la interfaz y dejar la pantalla de error de Decky al arrancar. Ahora Steam abre con normalidad y Panel funciona en el menú de acceso rápido.
- **Reportes después de un bloqueo:** Si la consola se queda congelada y hay que forzar el reinicio, Panel conserva lo que estaba pasando en los minutos anteriores (memoria, gráfica, juego y tema activos) y lo incluye en el siguiente reporte, para poder encontrar la causa.

### What's new

- **Steam no longer crashes on the beta:** On Steam's beta client, Panel could take down the whole interface and leave Decky's error screen on startup. Steam now opens normally and Panel works in the Quick Access menu.
- **Reports after a freeze:** If the device freezes and you have to force a restart, Panel keeps what was happening in the minutes before (memory, GPU, game and active theme) and includes it in the next report, so the cause can be found.

### Novità

- **Steam non si blocca più con la beta:** Con il client beta di Steam, Panel poteva far cadere tutta l'interfaccia e lasciare la schermata di errore di Decky all'avvio. Ora Steam si apre normalmente e Panel funziona nel menu di accesso rapido.
- **Segnalazioni dopo un blocco:** Se la console si blocca e devi forzare il riavvio, Panel conserva quello che stava succedendo nei minuti precedenti (memoria, GPU, gioco e tema attivo) e lo include nella segnalazione successiva, così da trovarne la causa.

### Neuigkeiten

- **Steam stürzt mit der Beta nicht mehr ab:** Mit dem Beta-Client von Steam konnte Panel die gesamte Oberfläche zum Absturz bringen und beim Start den Fehlerbildschirm von Decky hinterlassen. Jetzt startet Steam normal und Panel funktioniert im Schnellzugriffsmenü.
- **Berichte nach einem Einfrieren:** Wenn das Gerät einfriert und du einen Neustart erzwingen musst, behält Panel, was in den Minuten davor passiert ist (Speicher, GPU, Spiel und aktives Theme), und fügt es dem nächsten Bericht bei, damit sich die Ursache finden lässt.

### Novidades em português (Brasil)

- **O Steam não cai mais na beta:** Com o cliente beta do Steam, o Panel podia derrubar toda a interface e deixar a tela de erro do Decky ao iniciar. Agora o Steam abre normalmente e o Panel funciona no menu de acesso rápido.
- **Relatórios depois de um travamento:** Se o aparelho travar e for preciso forçar o reinício, o Panel guarda o que estava acontecendo nos minutos anteriores (memória, GPU, jogo e tema ativo) e inclui isso no próximo relatório, para que a causa possa ser encontrada.

### Nouveautés

- **Steam ne plante plus avec la bêta :** Avec le client bêta de Steam, Panel pouvait faire tomber toute l'interface et laisser l'écran d'erreur de Decky au démarrage. Steam s'ouvre maintenant normalement et Panel fonctionne dans le menu d'accès rapide.
- **Rapports après un blocage :** Si l'appareil se fige et qu'il faut forcer le redémarrage, Panel conserve ce qui se passait dans les minutes précédentes (mémoire, GPU, jeu et thème actif) et l'inclut dans le rapport suivant, pour pouvoir en trouver la cause.

hooandee/panel-de-control.name: panel-de-control: v0.80.2
hooandee/panel-de-control.body:
### Novedades

- **TDP en la ROG Xbox Ally X 20:** Panel controla el TDP de este modelo aunque tu kernel todavía no lo reconozca, respetando los mínimos de potencia del fabricante. Si el consumo supera el límite elegido, Panel intenta corregirlo y te avisa si no lo consigue.
- **Aviso de kernel sin soporte:** Potencia muestra un aviso, que puedes descartar, cuando el kernel aún no incluye los límites de potencia de tu máquina. Al actualizar a un kernel compatible, Panel pasa solo al método nuevo.

### What's new

- **TDP on the ROG Xbox Ally X 20:** Panel controls TDP on this model even when your kernel doesn't recognise it yet, keeping to the manufacturer's minimum power limits. If power draw goes above the chosen limit, Panel tries to correct it and lets you know if it can't.
- **Kernel support notice:** Power shows a dismissible notice when your kernel doesn't include your device's power limits yet. Once you update to a supported kernel, Panel switches to the new method on its own.

### Novità

- **TDP sulla ROG Xbox Ally X 20:** Panel controlla il TDP di questo modello anche quando il tuo kernel non lo riconosce ancora, rispettando i limiti minimi di potenza del produttore. Se il consumo supera il limite scelto, Panel prova a correggerlo e ti avvisa se non ci riesce.
- **Avviso di kernel non supportato:** Potenza mostra un avviso, che puoi chiudere, quando il kernel non include ancora i limiti di potenza del tuo dispositivo. Quando aggiorni a un kernel compatibile, Panel passa da solo al nuovo metodo.

### Neuigkeiten

- **TDP auf dem ROG Xbox Ally X 20:** Panel steuert die TDP dieses Modells, auch wenn dein Kernel es noch nicht erkennt, und hält dabei die Mindestleistungsgrenzen des Herstellers ein. Liegt der Verbrauch über dem gewählten Limit, versucht Panel das zu korrigieren und sagt dir Bescheid, wenn es nicht gelingt.
- **Hinweis zur Kernel-Unterstützung:** Leistung zeigt einen ausblendbaren Hinweis, solange dein Kernel die Leistungsgrenzen deines Geräts noch nicht enthält. Nach dem Update auf einen unterstützten Kernel wechselt Panel von selbst zur neuen Methode.

### Novidades em português (Brasil)

- **TDP no ROG Xbox Ally X 20:** O Panel controla o TDP deste modelo mesmo quando o seu kernel ainda não o reconhece, respeitando os limites mínimos de potência do fabricante. Se o consumo passar do limite escolhido, o Panel tenta corrigir e avisa se não conseguir.
- **Aviso de kernel sem suporte:** Potência mostra um aviso, que você pode dispensar, quando o kernel ainda não inclui os limites de potência do seu dispositivo. Ao atualizar para um kernel compatível, o Panel passa sozinho para o método novo.

### Nouveautés

- **TDP sur la ROG Xbox Ally X 20 :** Panel contrôle le TDP de ce modèle même lorsque votre noyau ne le reconnaît pas encore, en respectant les limites de puissance minimales du fabricant. Si la consommation dépasse la limite choisie, Panel tente de la corriger et vous prévient s'il n'y parvient pas.
- **Avis de noyau non pris en charge :** Puissance affiche un avis, que vous pouvez masquer, lorsque le noyau n'inclut pas encore les limites de puissance de votre appareil. Après la mise à jour vers un noyau compatible, Panel passe tout seul à la nouvelle méthode.

gillrajvir950-wq/deckyshare.name: DeckyShare v1.3.1
gillrajvir950-wq/deckyshare.body:
- Phones and computers can no longer look through files on your Deck. You choose what to send on the Deck.
- The iPhone Shortcut / Android app access now shows up under Remembered devices and can be reset. Forget all resets it too.
- Access keys and pairing codes are no longer written to the Decky log.
- New: More → Updates now shows what changed in each version.

gillrajvir950-wq/deckyshare.name: DeckyShare v1.3.0
gillrajvir950-wq/deckyshare.body:
Everything from the 1.3.0 test builds, tested on a Steam Deck OLED with an iPhone:

- **Screenshots**: pick Steam screenshots (grouped by game) and send them to the phone as a gallery; on iPhone press and hold → Save to Photos.
- **ROMs straight into EmuDeck / RetroDECK**: received game files go into the matching `roms/<system>` folder wherever EmuDeck keeps it (internal or SD card). Disc images are recognised by their content; unclear formats stay in Downloads with a **Move to EmuDeck** button.
- **Clipboard** between phone/PC and Deck: Text tab on the phone page, Clipboard section on the Deck with Copy, **Paste** (reads the Deck clipboard), Open link and **Type on Deck**.
- **Remembered devices**: connect once; after a Deck restart just open the address again. Manage them under Settings & support.
- New controller highlight (the whole card lights up), buttons sized correctly on the Deck, phone tabs no longer wrap.

gillrajvir950-wq/deckyshare.name: DeckyShare v1.2.0
gillrajvir950-wq/deckyshare.body: - **Game clips**: a new "Game clips" section lists your Steam game recordings. Tap one and DeckyShare turns it into a regular MP4 (no re-encoding, same quality) and offers it on the phone page under **Get from Deck**. Works in Gaming Mode and for clips of any length (Steam itself only sends clips up to 59 seconds to a phone). A copy is kept in `Videos/Steam Clips`.

gillrajvir950-wq/deckyshare.name: DeckyShare v1.1.1
gillrajvir950-wq/deckyshare.body: - The Deck panel now retries for up to ~30 seconds while Decky starts the backend after an install or update, instead of showing "Backend startup timed out" right away.

gillrajvir950-wq/deckyshare.name: DeckyShare v1.1.0
gillrajvir950-wq/deckyshare.body:
First stable release since v1.0.0. Everything from the 1.1.0 release candidates, summarised:

### Security
- Access now requires the session token from the QR code, or a one-time 6-digit code for computers (expires after 10 minutes, rate limited). v1.0.0 accepted anyone on the same network: please upgrade.
- Decky-only endpoints accept local requests only; uploads are verified and written to temporary files first.

### Connecting
- Phone: scan the QR code. Computer: open the short address (for example `192.168.8.131:8787`) and type the code shown on the Deck.

### Transfers
- Maximum Speed (single stream) plus resumable Turbo (3 parallel streams) and Fast modes, with pause, resume and cancel.
- Live speed and time left, and a "stalled" warning when no data arrives. Short phone pauses (up to 5 minutes) no longer kill a transfer.
- Cancel transfers from the Deck panel as well as from the phone/computer.
- Re-sending a file you deleted keeps its original name (no more "name (1)").
- Files received are listed with the sending device ("From iPhone", "From Mac", ...).

### Steam Deck panel
- Redesigned panel: transfer card at the top, QR + computer code, Send to phone, Received files, Recent, and a More group with Wi-Fi, Updates and Settings & support. New icon set and logo.
- Controller-friendly file manager: browse, copy, move, rename, new folder, move to trash.
- Wi-Fi check showing band, link speed, signal and power saving, with hints when Wi-Fi limits speed.
- Built-in updater that installs verified GitHub releases through Decky.

### Phone / computer page
- Redesigned page with Send to Deck / Get from Deck tabs, a file list you can edit, drag and drop on computers, and a large progress card.

### Project
- The Deck panel is built from source in CI; releases are built, tested and verified automatically.
- Optional self-hosted custom Decky store (`store/`).

brenticusmaximus/themedeck.name: ThemeDeck v3.1.4
brenticusmaximus/themedeck.body:
Fixes YouTube previews and downloads failing with **“ffprobe and ffmpeg not found.”** ThemeDeck now downloads M4A audio directly, removing the MP3 conversion step and its FFmpeg/FFprobe requirement. Existing music and assignments continue to work.

This should also fix the same Python error caused by missing FFmpeg/FFprobe on non-Steam Deck devices, including devices such as the ROG ALLY X20. The fix removes that dependency on all devices; it has been confirmed on a Steam Deck, with other-device testing still welcome.

Also included since v3.0.2:
- Downloader runtime checks, working fallback selection, and automatic repair when no working downloader is available.
- Persistent preview/download errors and full preview traceback logging.
- Optional Deck Shelves sources for games with music, games without music, and recently assigned music; music filters and assignment-date sorting.
- Assignment-date recording and estimated creation-date recovery for older YouTube downloads.

**Install:** Download **ThemeDeck-v3.1.4.zip** below, copy it to your Steam Deck, and choose **Decky Settings → Developer → Install Plugin from ZIP File**. Use the plugin ZIP rather than the source-code archives.

Validation: preview, cached-preview, and assignment checks without FFmpeg/FFprobe; downloader health and repair checks; assignment-date and Deck Shelves checks; exception-display checks; production build and ZIP integrity verification. The audio fix was confirmed working on a Steam Deck.

brenticusmaximus/themedeck.name: ThemeDeck v3.0.2
brenticusmaximus/themedeck.body:
## Sleep/wake playback fix

- Preserves global ambient playback position before sleep.
- Releases browser audio and visualizer resources during suspension.
- Rebuilds playback and refreshes Steam runtime state after wake.
- Retries playback while the Steam UI finishes resuming.
- Repairs stale playback state when the browser audio element is actually paused.

Fixes #29.

brenticusmaximus/themedeck.name: ThemeDeck v3.0.1
brenticusmaximus/themedeck.body:
## Fixes

- Fixes the auto-assign missing game tracks feature reporting zero games when Steam's frontend library cache is unavailable or empty.
- Adds a backend Steam library scan using the Deck's local Steam files so all/installed/uninstalled/missing-game bulk actions can find the real library.

## Verification

- Confirmed on Steam Deck that ThemeDeck now detects the game library correctly.
- Built with `pnpm build`.
- Validated backend syntax with `python3 -m py_compile main.py`.

brenticusmaximus/themedeck.name: ThemeDeck v3.0.0
brenticusmaximus/themedeck.body:
ThemeDeck v3.0.0 focuses on making game music assignment practical when your Steam Deck is docked or using an external controller.

## Highlights

- Added controller-first navigation to the "Choose ThemeDeck music..." assignment screen.
- Improved YouTube search fallback for game names with special characters, including trademark symbols.
- Added local cached YouTube previews so preview playback works more reliably in Gaming Mode.
- Added clearer Currently assigned highlighting when a YouTube result matches the track already assigned to the current game.
- Added debug logging at `/home/deck/ThemeDeck/themedeck-debug.log`.

## Controller Controls For Assigning Music

1. Open a game page and choose **Choose ThemeDeck music...**.
2. Use the D-pad to move through the search field, Search button, YouTube results, and **Or, browse local files**.
3. Press **A** on **Search** to search YouTube for the current query.
4. In YouTube results:
   - D-pad **left/right** moves between search results.
   - D-pad **up/down** switches between **Play Preview** and **Download & Assign** inside the current result.
   - Press **A** on **Play Preview** to start or stop a preview.
   - Press **A** on **Download & Assign** to download that result and assign it to the current game.
   - Press **B** to go back.
   - From the first result, D-pad **left** returns to the search controls.
   - From the last result, D-pad **right** moves down to **Or, browse local files**.
5. Use **Or, browse local files** if you want to assign a local audio file instead of a YouTube result.

## Install

Download `ThemeDeck-v3.0.0.zip` from this release. Do not use GitHub's source-code ZIP for Decky installation.

🎮 TitleDeck 1.2.1 Stable

Your Library. Your Names. Your Descriptions.

TitleDeck 1.2.1 brings a major quality-of-life improvement to Steam Deck customization, making it faster and easier than ever to personalize your Steam library.

What started as a simple game-renaming plugin has evolved into a complete library customization experience, supporting both Steam games and non-Steam shortcuts.

✨ What’s New in 1.2.1?

🎮 Native Steam Context Menu Integration

You can now highlight any game in your Steam library, press the Options (☰) button, and select Edit with TitleDeck.

TitleDeck opens directly to that game’s editor without requiring you to search through your library.

Works with both Steam and non-Steam games!

⚡ Faster, Smoother Editing

The new direct-editor system eliminates the unnecessary library-loading screen and artwork flash when launching TitleDeck from a game’s context menu.

Select your game, open TitleDeck, and start editing.

🎨 Customizable Context Menu Placement

Choose where Edit with TitleDeck appears in Steam’s game Options menu.

Available placements include:

* After Developer (default)
* Before Properties, with intelligent positioning for non-Steam games

Your renamed games now display their custom titles in the STEAM-button menu while running!

For example:

* Catherine Classic → Catherine
* Need for Speed Most Wanted Black Edition → Need for Speed Most Wanted!

This works with Steam and non-Steam games, survives restarts in tested scenarios, and can be enabled or disabled through TitleDeck’s Full Library Manager settings.

When editing a game through the new context-menu shortcut, hold B / Circle for 650 milliseconds to return directly to Steam.

A normal tap still performs the usual Back action.

No more backing through multiple menus!

✅ Everything You Already Love

TitleDeck continues to support custom game names, personalized Game Info descriptions, original-title restoration, artwork preservation, controller navigation, library search, backups, and appearance customization.

All changes remain local and reversible. TitleDeck never modifies your installed game files.

🧪 Tested on Real Hardware

TitleDeck 1.2.1 has been tested on a physical Steam Deck running SteamOS Gaming Mode.

Both Steam and non-Steam context-menu editing, HOME-menu title replacement, customizable menu positioning, and the new 650 ms controller shortcut have passed hardware testing.

❤️ Built for the Steam Deck Community

TitleDeck continues to evolve through community suggestions, real-world testing, and feedback.

Thank you to everyone who has supported the project, reported issues, and suggested new features.

Your games. Your library. Your way.

Enjoy TitleDeck 1.2.1! 🎮

valentinebsaa/game-theme-music.body:
# Game Theme Music 3.7.0 | Optional Mini Player HUD

**Stable release | October 28, 2026 | Steam Deck / Decky Loader**

## What's new
Game Theme Music 3.7.0 adds **Show mini player HUD** at **Settings → Interface & Feedback**. The setting is **ON by default** to preserve the familiar SAO-style Now Playing ribbon.

Turn it **OFF** to hide the mini player while game, Ambient, Steam Store and Plugin Store soundtracks continue to play normally. Turn it **ON** to restore the mini player for new playback events.

- The preference survives a Steam Deck restart.
- Hiding the HUD never turns off soundtrack playback.
- The visibility switch is independent of theme notifications, HUD position and visualizer.
- Disabling the HUD clears pending and interrupted popups, including queued Quick Access events.
- GTM 3.6.9's cooperative ResonaDeck audio focus is preserved.

## Physical Steam Deck checks
Developer-tested with **Catherine Classic** (Steam game), **Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005)** (non-Steam shortcut), the **native Steam Store**, the **Decky Plugin Store**, and **Ambient music on the Home screen**. Music continued while the mini player was hidden. The OFF preference survived a **full Steam Deck restart**, and re-enabling the HUD restored its popups.

These are tests on one developer-owned Steam Deck, not a guarantee of compatibility with every Decky, SteamOS or CSS Loader combination.

## Community credit
**Special thanks to Dollet** for reporting the missing mini-player visibility control in the Game Theme Music Discord bug-reports channel. The feedback directly inspired this release.

## Installation
Download **Game-Theme-Music-3.7.0.zip** from this release's Assets and install through Decky Loader's manual/developer plugin installation flow. Existing settings and playlists are designed to be preserved. Report unexpected behavior in GitHub Issues.

## Development and licensing
Game Theme Music continues the GPL-licensed OMGDuke → MegalonVII → Valentine lineage. This release was developed with AI-assisted coding under Valentine's direction and physically tested on Steam Deck. The published repository contains the editable Python backend and compiled JavaScript frontend, but not the original TS/TSX source needed for a fully reproducible frontend build. See SOURCE.md and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

valentinebsaa/resonadeck.body:
# 🎧 ResonaDeck 1.2.1 Stable

**Your Plex audio library, right where you play.** ResonaDeck provides music, audiobooks, podcasts, and other Plex audio in Steam Deck's Quick Access Menu and Full Manager.

## 🆕 New in 1.2.1: Easier updates

- **Direct Updater support:** ResonaDeck now supplies canonical GitHub repository metadata, helping the independent [Decky Direct Updater](https://deckyup.nukeador.com/) find the correct official source.
- **Consistent identity:** Release version `1.2.1` is synchronized between the plugin manifest, package metadata, frontend display and backend fallback.
- **Compatible ZIP:** The [published stable release](https://github.com/ValentineBSAA/ResonaDeck/releases/tag/1.2.1) includes a single, installable `ResonaDeck-1.2.1-Stable.zip` asset.
- **Manual installs still work:** Direct Updater is completely optional.

**This is a distribution maintenance release, not a playback redesign.** Surprise Me, Keep Playing, Favorites, configurable music crossfade, XFADE indicators, animated vinyl handoff, Plex browsing, controller navigation and artwork-colored glass remain as before.

## ⬇️ Install or update

**Option A: Direct Updater.** Install [Decky Direct Updater](https://deckyup.nukeador.com/), search for **`ValentineBSAA/ResonaDeck`**, choose the official repository, select Install or Update and confirm. An older 1.2.0 installation may request a one-time source confirmation. Nothing installs without confirmation.

**Option B: Manual ZIP.** Download [ResonaDeck-1.2.1-Stable.zip](https://github.com/ValentineBSAA/ResonaDeck/releases/download/1.2.1/ResonaDeck-1.2.1-Stable.zip). Enable Developer Mode in Decky Settings → General, then select Developer → Install Plugin from ZIP.

## 🎮 Controller quick start

Focus the gold Surprise Me turntable. Press **A** to start and **X** to open or close settings. When music is playing, **X** on the active album artwork opens those settings without stopping music. On regular library items, **X** continues opening media actions such as Add to Queue, Play Next, or Browse Details.

## ✅ Verification

**Already confirmed on Steam Deck in 1.2.0:** Surprise Me, Keep Playing, Favorites, the automatic eight-second crossfade and animated record-to-cover handoff.

**Verified offline in 1.2.1:** Published archive hash, version consistency, official GitHub metadata and unchanged playback code. **Actual installation/upgrade through Direct Updater on Steam Deck remains unverified.** Broader 3/5/10-second crossfade and mixed codec testing is still welcome.

For feature details, see the [screenshots](SCREENSHOTS.md), [current test status](FEATURE_STATUS_1.2.1.md) and [support guide](SUPPORT.md).

Questions or bugs? Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/ValentineBSAA/ResonaDeck/issues). Never share Plex tokens or private server addresses.

Independent community project created by Valentine. Not affiliated with Plex, Valve, Steam or Decky Loader.

beallio/decky-metadata.name: v0.6.0 — Faster plugin, Steam match picker, and removed metadata stays removed
beallio/decky-metadata.body:
Faster plugin, Steam match picker, and removed metadata stays removed

### Added

- **Pick a Steam match in the editor.** In a game's editor, search Steam and
  compare the results by artwork, developer, and release date. Select **Use
  this Steam match** to save one. Looking at results or selecting Cancel
  changes nothing, and Cancel returns you to the result you had selected.
- You can still type a Steam App ID or paste a Steam page link, and IGN search
  is still there. Choosing a Steam match does not rename the shortcut or
  replace your custom artwork.

### Changed

- **Faster plugin.** The part of the plugin that runs in the background was
  rewritten. Saving a game's details is much faster, also with large
  libraries. It works with the standard Decky Loader and with the beallio
  Loader fork. Your saved details, settings, and shortcut-name history stay in
  place.
- The plugin loads less data when it starts and when you open the Quick Access
  panel. A game's Steam news now loads when you open that game.
- Each game's details are now kept in their own file, in a `metadata` folder
  next to the settings file. The first start after the update moves your
  existing details there.
- **Going back to an older version:** use the plugin's built-in updater. It
  first copies your details back into the single settings file, so the older
  version still finds them. An older version that you install by hand from a
  ZIP file does not show your saved details.
- On the standard Decky Loader, the plugin gives back memory it used for large
  data transfers when it is idle.
- Updated the tools used to build and test the plugin, to fix reported security
  problems. These tools are not part of the installed plugin.

### Fixed

- **Removed metadata stays removed.** After **Remove metadata**, the plugin no
  longer matches that game again by itself. Before, the background news update
  could match the game's name to a Steam game about 15 minutes later, and the
  news came back. Opening the game no longer fetches IGN details for it, and
  **Refresh metadata** skips it. To match the game again, pick a Steam match or
  an IGN result in its editor, or use **Clear cache**. If you removed a game's
  metadata before this update, remove it once more after you update. Fix for
  [issue #3](https://github.com/beallio/Decky-Metadata/issues/3).
- If a game's news cannot load, its Activity tab keeps what it already showed.
- When you choose a different Steam match, the new store link and Steam name
  are kept.
- If the plugin cannot read its settings file, it no longer saves over that
  file, so your saved details are not lost.
- Screenshots that finish loading late no longer overwrite changes you made in
  the meantime.
- **View logs** now works even if the log file could not be set up when the
  plugin started.

beallio/decky-metadata.name: v0.5.5-dev.g8bdbff6 (Dev)
beallio/decky-metadata.body:
Automated development pre-release built from commit 8bdbff6a6716b842be39ff7cfb587d6ed34e646b.

Find Steam matches and run the plugin backend in Rust

### Added

- Added Steam search to the per-game editor. Compare results using real artwork,
  developer names, and release dates where available, then select **Use this
  Steam match** to save the match. Browsing and cancelling do not change saved
  metadata, and Cancel returns controller focus to the selected result.
- Manual Steam App ID and page-link entry remain available beside the separate
  IGN metadata search. Match confirmation does not rename shortcuts or replace
  custom artwork.

### Changed

- Replaced the plugin's Python backend with Rust. The same ZIP runs directly on
  the beallio Loader fork and uses a small compatibility shim on standard Decky
  Loader. Saved metadata, preferences, and shortcut-name restore history stay in place.
- Preserved provider-specific request headers. Log viewing retries file setup
  if it failed at startup.
- The plugin now loads less data when it starts and when you open the Quick Access
  panel. A game's Steam news loads when you open that game.
- Saving one game's metadata is much faster, also with large libraries. Each
  game's metadata is now kept in its own file in a `metadata` folder beside the
  settings file. The first start after the update moves existing metadata there.
- Before the built-in updater installs a different version, the plugin copies
  all metadata back into the single settings file, so an older version still
  finds it. An older version installed by hand from a ZIP gets no copy and does
  not show saved metadata; use the built-in updater to change versions.

### Fixed

- **Removed metadata stays removed.** After **Remove metadata**, the plugin no
  longer matches that game again by itself. Before, the background news refresh
  could match the game's title to a Steam game after about 15 minutes, and its
  news came back. Opening the game page also no longer fetches IGN metadata for
  it, and **Refresh metadata** skips it. To match the game again, pick a Steam
  match or an IGN result in its editor, or use **Clear cache**. Fix for
  [issue #3](https://github.com/beallio/Decky-Metadata/issues/3).

mdeguzis/decky-proton-pulse.name: Proton Pulse v1.15.0
mdeguzis/decky-proton-pulse.body:
Proton Pulse v1.15.0

- Accept Armada, Pocknix, and Android as valid OS entries, letting Retroid Pocket / AYN Odin / AyaNeo Pocket DS and DroidDeck users submit reports (refs mdeguzis/proton-pulse-web#544)
- Multi-config-per-app: a game can now hold any number of named launch-option profiles ('Default', '60fps low', 'framegen', etc.). Save creates a new profile when the name differs; matching names still upsert. Storage keyed by (appId, profileName); Supabase user_proton_configs schema migrated to a composite (voter_id, app_id, profile_name) primary key.
- Save vs Apply split in the Config Editor: Save persists to storage + cloud without touching Steam launch options or bumping the active slot. Apply writes to Steam launch options + promotes the profile to ACTIVE. Save-only profiles no longer steal ACTIVE from a profile you are currently playing.
- ACTIVE badge on the row whose profile is currently applied. Playtime attributes to that specific profile.
- Per-config Pending Approval / Published pills. Two profiles on the same game no longer both light up when only one was submitted; each row reflects its own report state via config_key. Legacy null-key submissions from before this fix light up only the ACTIVE profile as a fallback.
- Submit modal fires onSubmitted so the Manage tab refreshes the row status without waiting for a remount.
- Submit modal is passed configKey so the DB row's config_key is populated. Report status becomes truly per-profile going forward.
- Plugin submits now set game_owned=true. The admin report detail no longer shows 'Game Owned: false' for plugin-sourced reports.
- 'Applied X ago' meta line now ticks live: ManageTab subscribes to onConfigSaved (immediate refresh after Apply / Reapply) plus a 60s tick so the relative label doesn't go stale.
- Draft pill hidden when there is no submitted report for a profile. SYNCED green badge already covers the cloud state; the extra 'Draft' gray pill next to it read as noise.

necrosiak/steamcord.name: v1.43.0 — Windows support
necrosiak/steamcord.body:
### New

- **Windows support.** Steamcord now runs in Steam Big Picture on Windows, with the official Decky Loader installed by [Playhub](https://github.com/LoZazaMastro/Playhub) or with musika08's [Decky Loader for Windows](https://github.com/musika08/decky-loader-windows). Voice, private messages, notifications, game activity, Go Live with sound and watching streams all work. Steamcord downloads its own private copy of Vesktop, so a Discord you already use on Windows is left alone. Features that rely on Linux components (audio pickers, game audio mixing, overlays, controller shortcuts) are hidden there. See [Steamcord on Windows](https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/blob/main/docs/WINDOWS.md).

### Improved

- **Streams you aren't watching stay quiet.** In Game Mode and on Windows, a stream shared in your voice channel no longer plays its sound until you press Watch, and closing the panel stops it again; voices and your volume settings are untouched. Thanks to [@jckirton](https://github.com/jckirton) for the suggestion in [#83](https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/issues/83).

### Fixes

- The in-game overlay is no longer reported as unavailable when Steamcord starts: the check that looks for it now runs in the same clean environment as the overlay itself.

### Thanks

Thanks to [@SilvertongueRED](https://github.com/SilvertongueRED), whose [Windows fork](https://github.com/SilvertongueRED/Steamcord-for-Windows) showed the way for this port.

**Full changelog:** [v1.42.6...v1.43.0](https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/compare/v1.42.6...v1.43.0)

necrosiak/steamcord.name: v1.42.6 — Steam menu integration
necrosiak/steamcord.body:
### Improved

- **Steamcord in the Steam menu.** The entry now uses the plugin's name and opens the existing expanded view. Steamcord, SkullKey and BoneCast can each keep their own entry when installed together.

### Fixes

- Reopening the Steam menu or reloading a plugin no longer adds another entry. Older duplicate Discord entries are cleaned up too.

### Thanks

Thanks to [@cymbatpd23](https://github.com/cymbatpd23) for reporting the repeated entries in [#84](https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/issues/84).

**Full changelog:** [v1.42.5...v1.42.6](https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/compare/v1.42.5...v1.42.6)

necrosiak/steamcord.name: v1.42.5
necrosiak/steamcord.body:
## Steamcord 1.42.5

### Fixed

- **Discord stays off after a restart.** Turning Discord off from Steamcord's settings only lasted until the next reboot, then Vesktop started again on its own. Steamcord now remembers the switch: Discord stays off until you turn it back on, and the rest of Steamcord starts normally meanwhile. Thanks to [@prozac192](https://github.com/prozac192) for the report ([#82](https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/issues/82)).

necrosiak/steamcord.name: v1.42.4
necrosiak/steamcord.body:
## Fixed

- **Discord entry in the Steam menu** — the "Discord" item of Steam's main menu (Steam button) no longer appeared, because Steam changed how its menu items are built. It is back, shows once you are signed in, and opens Steamcord's expanded view. Opening the Steam menu while that view is open closes it, and a second press returns to your game. Thanks to @theupriser for the fix and the tests (#80).
- **Games started from Battle.net** — a Proton game launched through Battle.net showed only "Battle.net" without artwork in your Discord status. Steamcord now treats Battle.net as a launcher, reads Windows paths correctly, and tells apart games that share an executable, so World of Warcraft, World of Warcraft Classic and World of Warcraft: Forever each show under their own name. The path fix also helps other Proton games started from a launcher. Thanks to @mweitl for the analysis and the patch (#81).

## New Contributors
* @theupriser made their first contribution in https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/pull/80
* @mweitl contributed the Battle.net detection fix from https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/issues/81

Steamcord updates itself; you can also install `Steamcord.zip` below.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/compare/v1.42.3...v1.42.4

necrosiak/steamcord.name: v1.42.3
necrosiak/steamcord.body:
### Fixed

- **Notifications from other plugins** — Steamcord replaced Decky's shared
  notification system, so other plugins could not dismiss the notifications
  they showed, and an old workaround removed Decky's wrapper around Steam's
  notification renderer. Steamcord now leaves both alone and uses Decky's own
  API for its native notification mode. Its chat-style notifications, click
  actions, sounds and streamer mode are unchanged. Thanks to
  [deathtenk](https://github.com/deathtenk) for the fix and the tests
  ([#78](https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/pull/78)).



## What's Changed
* fix: preserve Decky notification APIs and renderer instrumentation by @deathtenk in https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/pull/78

## New Contributors
* @deathtenk made their first contribution in https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/pull/78

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Necrosiak/Steamcord/compare/v1.42.2...v1.42.3

mimed95/decky-voxtype.name: 0.2.0 Fixed naming and build pipeline
mimed95/decky-voxtype.body:
## Changes

- **Plugin identifier unified as `decky-voxtype`.** Appears under that name in Decky Loader; previously registered as "Voxtype", which diverged from the directory, package name, and zip filename.
- **Single source of truth for the name.** Defined once in `plugin.json`; consumed at runtime via `@decky/manifest`, in packaging via `jq`, and in CI via a metadata step.
- **Release pipeline fixed.** The `0.1.0` release shipped with no zip attached because the CI upload gate was `refs/tags/v*` and the tag was `0.1.0`. Both the trigger filter and the upload gate now accept any tag.
- **Packaging hardening.** `scripts/pack.sh` now copies `dist/*.js` (not only `index.js`), guarding against future Rollup code-splitting.
- **Dependency alignment.** Pinned `@types/react-router@5.1.20` to match Decky Loader upstream and `@decky/api`'s own devDeps — resolves a dangling type import under `tsc --noEmit`.

mimed95/decky-voxtype.name: First Release 0.1.0
mimed95/decky-voxtype.body:
# Voxtype v0.1.0 — voice dictation comes to Steam Deck Game Mode

  **The first voice-typing plugin for Decky Loader.** Press a controller button, speak, release — and the
  transcription lands on your system clipboard, ready to paste into any text field on your Deck. Fully local,
   fully offline, built on [voxtype](https://github.com/peteonrails/voxtype) and [whisper.cpp](https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp).

  No cloud. No API key. No account. Your voice never leaves the Deck.

  ## Highlights

  - **Controller-native push-to-talk.** Bind any button (or a two-button chord) directly through the plugin's
   settings. No fiddling with Steam Input keyboard mappings; the plugin listens at the Steam Input layer
  itself. Default: **R4** back grip.
  - **Vulkan acceleration on the Deck's GPU.** Ships with both an AVX2 CPU build and a Vulkan-enabled build
  of voxtype. One toggle switches between them — no `pacman`, no read-only root gymnastics, no lingering
  system packages after SteamOS updates.
  - **Works in the background.** Recording fires even when the Decky menu is closed. Open a search box, hold
  your PTT button, speak. Clipboard updated.
  - **Multiple Whisper models.** `tiny.en` / `base.en` / `small.en` / `medium.en` plus multilingual
  equivalents. Base (~140 MB) is the default and is plenty accurate for most dictation. Download from the
  plugin settings.
  - **Fails gracefully.** Idempotent daemon lifecycle, `prctl(PR_SET_PDEATHSIG)` so voxtype processes can
  never be orphaned, `--no-hotkey` so the daemon doesn't fight with the OS, truncated per-run crash log at
  `/home/deck/homebrew/logs/decky-voxtype/voxtype-daemon.log`.

  ## What you get

  - Push-to-talk via any Deck button or chord.
  - Optional two-button chord mode for PTT without a dedicated button.
  - CPU or GPU backend, switchable at runtime.
  - Auto-start on boot (opt-out).
  - A "Listening to voice input" toast when recording begins, and a preview toast with your transcription
  when it completes.

  ## Install

  1. Download `decky-voxtype-v0.1.0.zip` below.
  2. In Desktop Mode: Decky → Settings → Developer → Install from URL / zip, or drop the unzipped folder into
   `/home/deck/homebrew/plugins/`.
  3. In Game Mode: open the plugin, flip **Enable Voxtype**, download the `base.en` model from the Settings
  panel (one-time, ~140 MB).
  4. Pick your PTT button. Press it. Talk.

  ## Requirements

  - Steam Deck (OLED or LCD). Linux x86_64 with Vulkan support works too.
  - Decky Loader installed.
  - ~180 MB of disk space (binaries + default model).
  - A working microphone (Deck's built-in mic is fine).

  ## Known limitations

  - Model downloads use voxtype's built-in setup path; first download runs synchronously from the plugin
  panel.
  - Auto-paste (Ctrl+V) mode is intentionally not shipped — on SteamOS it would require `ydotool`, which
  SteamOS updates wipe. Clipboard + paste-from-OSK is the supported flow.
  - Transcription quality follows the Whisper model you pick. For games/apps with unusual vocabulary, the
  `small.en` model is a meaningful upgrade over `base.en` at the cost of longer transcription time.

  ## Thanks

  - [peteonrails/voxtype](https://github.com/peteonrails/voxtype) — the whisper.cpp-based daemon doing the
  actual speech recognition.
  - [SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader) — the plugin
  platform.
  - [decky-lsfg-vk](https://github.com/pluto2023/decky-lsfg-vk) — reference for the Web Clipboard pattern
  used for output.
  - Whisper by OpenAI, whisper.cpp by ggerganov.

  ---

  First release. Feedback, bug reports, and feature requests welcome in Issues.

jjuuzzii/decky-ha-mqtt-plugin.name: v0.6.1 - Volume-routing boot delay + TV-clobbering fixes
jjuuzzii/decky-ha-mqtt-plugin.body:
### Fixed
- **Volume-routing boot delay**: after a reboot, the guide+stick volume shortcut sometimes fell back to SteamOS's normal volume slider instead of routing through this plugin, until a volume slider was touched manually. SteamOS only checks once, at Gamescope session start, whether the HDMI output supports external volume control — WirePlumber is now always restarted as the very first step of plugin startup (not only when its config changed) so the check has the best chance of succeeding on its own. Confirmed fixed across a real reboot.
- **TV sync blueprint**: none of the TV actions (Steam device turning on, volume buttons, mute, guide button) touch the TV anymore while it's on and showing something other than the configured HDMI input — previously the guide button and volume buttons would act on the TV regardless of what was currently on screen.
- **Blueprint crash**: leaving the volume buttons / guide button / Steam Link streaming entity inputs unset could crash automation validation ("Entity ID is not a valid entity ID"), since Home Assistant rejects an empty string as a target entity_id for the `event.received` trigger. Those inputs now default to a syntactically valid but nonexistent placeholder entity instead, which simply never fires.

jjuuzzii/decky-ha-mqtt-plugin.name: v0.6.0 - Steam Link streaming detection for the TV sync blueprint
jjuuzzii/decky-ha-mqtt-plugin.body:
### Added
- **Steam Link streaming sensor**: a new `binary_sensor` reflects whether the device is actively streaming to a Steam Link / Remote Play client, published on the retained `<base>/streaming` topic. Detected via `SteamClient.RemotePlay.RegisterForDevicesChanges` (undocumented, community-reverse-engineered, see the README note).
- The [TV sync blueprint](blueprints/automation/steamos_tv_sync.yaml) uses it: starting a stream turns the TV off (only if it's on the right HDMI input), ending the stream turns it back on — with a fix so the existing "TV off suspends the Steam device" rule doesn't fire because of this new TV-off action.

### Fixed
- Entity pickers in the blueprint no longer include a non-functional `integration: mqtt` filter where it wasn't narrowing anything on some Home Assistant versions; kept where it's paired with `device_class` (the power sensor), which does narrow correctly.

jjuuzzii/decky-ha-mqtt-plugin.name: v0.5.0 - Current app sensor + update notifications
jjuuzzii/decky-ha-mqtt-plugin.body:
### Added
- **Current App sensor**: Home Assistant now shows which game/app is running (including non-Steam shortcuts), published on the retained `<base>/app` topic — great for automations like "dim the lights when a game starts". Also shown in the plugin's Live Status panel.
- **Update notifications**: the plugin checks GitHub for new releases (on boot and twice daily). You get a toast in Game Mode when an update is available, a version notice with a release-page button in the plugin panel, and an update entity in Home Assistant.

jjuuzzii/decky-ha-mqtt-plugin.name: v0.4.0
jjuuzzii/decky-ha-mqtt-plugin.body:
### Added
- Home Assistant blueprint (`blueprints/automation/steamos_tv_sync.yaml`) for a full Steam Machine ↔ TV sync: power on/off follow each other (with HDMI source switching and Wake-on-LAN), the Steam controller's volume buttons control the TV, and the guide button switches the HDMI input. Configurable per-state delays and per-direction on/off toggles, both collapsed with sensible defaults — just pick your entities instead of hand-writing the automation. One-click "My Home Assistant" import badge added to the README.
- Volume-button events (up/down/mute) are now debounced directly inside the plugin.

hostsrc/decky-prysm.body:
# Prysm v0.2.0 - First Public Release

Stream your Steam Deck screen to any browser on your network. One-tap start from Game Mode.

## Features

- **Two streaming methods** - choose in QAM settings:
  - MPEG-TS (~500ms latency) - stable, works on any browser
  - WebRTC (~200ms latency) - lower latency via MediaMTX
- **VAAPI hardware encoding** - H.264 on AMD GPU, near-zero CPU usage
- **Quality presets** - 480p30, 720p30, 720p60, 1080p30, 1080p60
- **Live stats in QAM** - viewers, bytes sent, encoder status
- **Auto-restart** on capture failure
- **Native Decky UI** - all standard Steam Deck components

## Install

1. Download `Prysm-v0.2.0.zip`
2. Extract `Prysm/` folder to `~/homebrew/plugins/` on your Steam Deck
3. Restart Decky Loader: `sudo systemctl restart plugin_loader`

Or one-liner:
```bash
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hostsrc/decky-prysm/main/install.sh | bash
```

## Requirements

- Steam Deck running SteamOS 3.5+
- Decky Loader installed
- Game must NOT have `ENABLE_GAMESCOPE_WSI=0` in launch options

## Performance (720p30 over WiFi/Ethernet)

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Bitrate | ~5 Mbps |
| Decoded FPS | 29 fps |
| Dropped frames | <1% |
| Buffer | 0.4s |
| CPU usage | <3% (VAAPI) |

## What's New

### Streaming
- kmsgrab capture with VAAPI H.264 hardware encoding
- HTTP MPEG-TS server with mpegts.js viewer (low-latency tuned)
- MediaMTX WebRTC backend as alternative streaming method
- Auto-restart on FFmpeg/capture failures
- TS packet-aligned reads to prevent sync errors
- ThreadingHTTPServer for non-blocking stats

### QAM Plugin
- Clean single-panel layout with Start Streaming as primary action
- Method selector (MPEG-TS / WebRTC)
- Quality presets (480p30 to 1080p60)
- Audio toggle
- Live stats: viewers, total sent, encoder status
- All native Decky UI components

### Infrastructure
- GitHub Actions CI/CD (build + release pipelines)
- Makefile with build/dist/deploy targets
- Distribution zip matching Decky Plugin Store requirements
- Full GPL-2.0 license

## Contributors

- [@hostsrc](https://github.com/hostsrc)
- Claude Opus 4.6 (AI pair programmer)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hostsrc/decky-prysm/commits/v0.2.0

kentronix57/decky-loader-xgmobile-manage.body:
# v0.2.4 - NVIDIA Driver Update, Kernel Validation & Stability Fixes

This release consolidates all improvements from the 0.2.4-beta cycle and resolves critical installation failures caused by recent upstream changes in the SteamOS Client Stable channel. 

### 🚀 Changelog

#### 📦 NVIDIA Driver Maintenance
* **Driver Bump:** Upgraded the backend driver to **610.43.02-3**.
* **Driver Version Decoupling:** Separated the core kernel driver versioning from the desktop settings application package, allowing for more flexible maintenance.
* **Deep Clean Uninstaller:** Enhanced the uninstaller script to track down and thoroughly purge stale, lingering files from older installations to prevent dependency conflicts.

#### 🎮 AMD / SteamOS Fixes
* **Display Priority Override:** Added experimental environment variable injection for AMD hardware configurations. This explicitly informs Gamescope to prioritize the external eGPU over the handheld's internal APU when entering Game Mode.
* **Fixed Background Installation Failures:** Adjusted the plugin backend to sanitize environment variables without stripping critical D-Bus routing. This restores DNS resolution and package syncing functionality for the UI-based installer.
* **Smarter Kernel Validation:** Overhauled the kernel-vs-repository check. The installer now translates and accurately compares the exact Valve revision strings (e.g., `-valve24.1` vs `.valve24.1`). If Valve pushes new headers to their repository before the OS update is applied, the script will safely halt and warn you, preventing broken DKMS builds.

#### 📱 UI & Plugin Stability
* **Decky UI Upgrade:** Bumped `@decky/ui` package version to **v4.11.4** to ensure proper rendering of UI dropdown menus and overlays.
* **Log Viewer Fixes:** Patched `LogViewerModal` to adapt to upstream structural changes and prevent potential overlay freezes.
* **Reboot Prompt Fix:** Resolved an issue where the system reboot pop-up would fail to display after completing a driver installation or uninstallation.

### ⚠️ Installation Notes
As always, after successfully installing or updating the NVIDIA drivers via the plugin, **please reboot your device** to activate the newly compiled kernel modules before connecting your XG Mobile.

## What's Changed
* Pull Request: v0.2.4-beta Update by @Kentronix57 in https://github.com/Kentronix57/Decky-Loader-XGMobile-Manager/pull/9
* Update to v0.2.4: Kernel Check Overhaul & SteamOS Environment Fixes by @Kentronix57 in https://github.com/Kentronix57/Decky-Loader-XGMobile-Manager/pull/11


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kentronix57/Decky-Loader-XGMobile-Manager/compare/v0.2.3...v0.2.4

kentronix57/decky-loader-xgmobile-manage.body:
# v0.2.3 - Switch to Desktop Functions and SteamOS Dynamic Kernel Support

This release brings highly requested quality-of-life features for users who prefer using their XG Mobile in Desktop Mode, along with a massive under-the-hood improvement for SteamOS NVIDIA users.

### 🎉 What's New

#### 🐧 SteamOS Dynamic Kernel Support
No more waiting for hardcoded updates when Valve pushes a new beta! The NVIDIA installation script has been completely rewritten to dynamically check your active kernel version and pull the exact matching headers. This means the plugin can now successfully compile DKMS drivers regardless of whether you are on the SteamOS **Stable**, **Beta**, or **Main** update channels.

#### 🖥️ Desktop Mode Integration
We've added a suite of new UI toggles to the Quick Access Menu to make docking into a desktop environment seamless:
* **Desktop on Enable:** Toggle this on to automatically transition your session into Desktop Mode the moment the XG Mobile finishes its hardware handshake.
* **Set Desktop to Default:** Force the device to always boot straight into Desktop Mode whenever the eGPU is connected and active.
* **Create Desktop Shortcuts:** A new one-click button that generates handy shortcuts right on your desktop for quick access to the manager.

### 📝 Documentation & Adjustments
* **README Overhaul:** Cleaned up the documentation and adjusted the compatibility matrices. 
* **BazziteOS Known Issue:** Added tracking for an upstream Bazzite bug where the system struggles to maintain a persistent desktop mode session while the eGPU is active (switching sessions may loop back or drop the display container). 

### 🛠️ Upgrading
To update, simply run the install command in your terminal.

*SteamOS NVIDIA Users:* If you are changing SteamOS branches to test the new dynamic headers, please remember to click **Reset Driver Environment** *before* you update your OS, then run the installer again after rebooting!

## What's Changed
* Update to v0.2.3 - Dynamic Headers & Desktop Integration by @Kentronix57 in https://github.com/Kentronix57/Decky-Loader-XGMobile-Manager/pull/7


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kentronix57/Decky-Loader-XGMobile-Manager/compare/v0.2.2...v0.2.3

ag69075/steamos_plugin_achievements.body:
fix: hide badge/bubble for 5 min on game launch

Remove RegisterForGameActionEnd and RegisterForAppLifetimeNotifications
handlers from registerGameActionTracking — both fire within seconds of
launch and were clearing the "launching" state prematurely, causing the
badge/bubble to reappear almost immediately.

Now rely solely on a 300 000 ms safety timer (5 min) started on
GameActionStart (LaunchApp).

ag69075/steamos_plugin_achievements.name: v1.2.3
ag69075/steamos_plugin_achievements.body:
v1.2.3: remove Web API fallback, hide badge during game launch

Fully remove the Steam Web API fallback path (SteamAchievementsClient,
api_key/steamid64 settings) from main.py — the badge now relies solely
on SteamClient.Apps.GetMyAchievementsForApp, no account setup required
Hide the badge while a game is launching, using
SteamClient.Apps.RegisterForGameActionStart/End ('LaunchApp' action),
registered once at plugin mount with a 20s safety timeout in case
GameActionEnd doesn't fire reliably
Restore badge z-index so it still renders above the native bottom bar
during normal library browsing
Update README (features, requirements, project structure, limitations)

zany130/rsm-decky.body:
`v1.0.0` marks the first fully stable release of **RSM-Decky** for per-game ReShade management on Steam Deck.  
This release focuses on reliability, clearer UI, and safer shader and add-on workflows.

### Highlights
- Stable end-to-end workflow for per-game ReShade install, update, and uninstall.
- Improved shader catalog refresh and downloaded repo update feedback.
- Clearer UI labels and action wording for easier navigation.
- More useful error messages based on Python traceback details.

### Fixes & Improvements
- Fixed a shader apply bug where a failed apply could remove existing shader configuration.
- Fixed uninstall cleanup to always remove tracked `d3dcompiler` files.
- Added add-on warning modal and removed confusing check action from the ReShade flow.
- Improved degraded catalog refresh behavior with clearer modal messaging.
- Removed misleading “zero updated” refresh messaging.
- Improved plugin fallback error wording and reduced noisy debug output in frontend logs.

### UX / Copy Polish
- Renamed shader/add-on tab buttons and other UI labels for clarity.
- Aligned install/update naming in UI and docs.
- Updated wording from “local clone” to “downloaded shader repos”.
- Cleaned up QAM text and action copy for consistency.

### Internal Cleanup
- Removed legacy helpers, dead debug scaffolding, and stale frontend typings.
- Finalized release metadata for `1.0.0`.

---

This release establishes a stable and reliable foundation for future improvements.

# NordVPN Decky Loader Plugin - v1.1.0 🚀

### 🌟 What's New
* **NordVPN Auto-Detection Guard:** The plugin now dynamically checks if the NordVPN CLI service is installed and running on your Steam Deck. If it's missing, it will gently prompt you with setup requirements instead of silently failing.
* **Custom Polling Interval Slider:** Take control of your resource usage. You can now adjust how frequently the plugin checks your connection status directly from the settings menu.
* **Settings Persistence:** The plugin now securely remembers your custom polling settings across Deck reboots and Game Mode restarts.

### 🔧 Bug Fixes
* **Resolved Polling Race Condition:** Fixed a bug where the background auto-refresh loop would instantly wipe out connection error texts before you had a chance to read what went wrong.

### 📦 Fast Installation / Update

rayekkk/deckyvibrancehdr.body:
### ✨ Added

- **About:** **Use Rayek's store** makes Rayek's store Decky's store channel after you confirm, so Decky's Store
  tab lists Rayek's plugins and offers their updates.

### 🔧 Changed

**Menu**
- Descriptions use plain words instead of terms such as LUT, EDID or gamut. Control names are unchanged.
- **Last applied** replaces "Last LUT sent" under **Now** and also appears for SDR on screens that use the
  additional colour table above 200%.
- While the plugin starts, the menu shows a spinner.
- If the plugin cannot start, it says **Decky Vibrance HDR unavailable** with the reason, a **Try again**
  button and the Updates section, so a broken install can still be updated.
- Texts use American spelling ("colors") and a single "…" character.
- While an external display is connected, it explains that your saved settings apply again once you
  unplug it.
- It checks for changes every 3 seconds while idle, and every second while colors are being prepared or
  something needs attention.

**Errors**
- A setting that fails after you close the menu now shows a **Decky Vibrance HDR** message with the
  reason, instead of the slider silently moving back the next time you open it.
- A change the plugin refuses now also says why under that switch, slider or **Back to defaults**, until
  you use that control again.

**About**
- It is the new last row of the menu. Its page shows the version, author and license, with **Updates** at
  the bottom; Updates is no longer on the main menu.

**Updates**
- Wording now matches the other plugins: **Installed version**, **Checking GitHub…**,
  **Download <version>** and **<version> downloaded**, with the saved file shown as `~/Downloads/…` and a shorter
  install hint.
- A failed check or download shows **Could not complete** with the reason in the section instead of a
  message over the screen.
- When no release can be offered (none published yet, or its ZIP is not ready), the section says why
  instead of "Up to date".

**Sliders**
- A switch or reset no longer jumps ahead of a slider change you made before it; changes reach the
  plugin in the order you made them.

### 🐛 Fixed

**Display**
- Disabling the plugin or restarting Decky puts the original colors back even when the plugin was in the
  middle of another display change.
- A screen that reports no EDID at all is treated as standard gamut, as gamescope does, so 101% no longer
  jumps to the strongest SDR setting there.
- An unusual HDR entry in a screen's EDID no longer hides what the rest of the EDID says about HDR.
- When the plugin starts while docked and the display server answers slowly, it no longer takes its
  color calibration from the external display.

**Sliders**
- Slider and switch changes wait less for background display checks when the display server answers
  slowly.

**Settings**
- Settings survive a power cut right after a change, and files left by an interrupted save are cleaned
  up.
- A damaged settings file no longer resets everything: the plugin goes back to the last good copy it
  keeps beside it, keeps the damaged file as `settings.json.corrupt-…` and says so in the menu.

**Updates**
- Downloads accept only the release ZIP GitHub lists for this plugin, with the exact size and SHA-256
  GitHub reports, and every file in it is checked before saving.
- A download is refused unless the release is newer than the installed one.
- Stopping or updating the plugin no longer waits for a slow or stuck update check.
- A download that ends early is reported as failed instead of being kept, and a download in progress
  stops when the plugin stops.

**Errors**
- Messages in the menu no longer show folders that contain your user name; the full details are in the
  Decky log.

### 🔧 Changed

**Menu**
- A backend that is slow to answer is shown as **Waiting for backend** (a change) or
  **Backend unavailable** (a read) instead of a silent spinner, also after the panel was closed and reopened.
- The **Retry** button is gone; the open panel already asks again every second, so it never did anything
  extra.
- Clearer wording for what to do when a setting cannot be applied, and for the SDR and HDR slider
  descriptions.

**Updates**
- The result fields can be reached with the gamepad, and the section keeps its focus when the plugin
  becomes ready or loses its display.

**Install**
- Instructions now match Decky: turn on Developer mode, choose **Browse** next to
  **Install Plugin from ZIP File**, accept Decky's warning and confirm. That replaces the installed version itself,
  so there is no need to uninstall first, and settings are always kept.

### 🐛 Fixed

**Settings**
- An empty settings file no longer keeps the controls paused forever. It can be left by an interrupted
  first start, or by version 1.0.0 after a power loss, and now loads as defaults.
- A settings file that cannot be used (broken JSON, wrong content, or nesting deep enough to break the
  reader) no longer stops the plugin or stalls startup.
- Such a file is kept as `settings.json.corrupt-<time>`, the plugin starts from defaults, and
  **Settings reset** in the menu names the kept file.
- Your last slider change is saved even when a slow display server delays shutdown.
- Disabling or uninstalling the plugin, or restarting Decky, saves your last slider change and puts the
  original colors back whenever Decky lets the plugin shut down.
- On Odin 3 this usually failed, because Decky stopped the plugin halfway and the effect stayed on
  screen until gamescope restarted. Decky can still stop a plugin before its shutdown starts
  ([decky-loader#975](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader/issues/975)): after a restart the plugin
  applies your settings again anyway, but after disabling or uninstalling the colors can stay until gamescope
  restarts.

**Display**
- A single slow display query no longer drops the plugin into **Plugin not ready** for a moment, and can
  no longer leave a false "another plugin" conflict warning behind. Only a real gamescope restart reconnects.
- A reconnect that fails with an error is retried instead of leaving the plugin not ready, and a color
  table that keeps failing is retried every 16 s rather than rebuilt every 4 s.
- Waking the device twice in quick succession reapplies your color settings again; before, the second
  wake could skip it until the next one.
- Waking up in a dock no longer sends the built-in screen's settings to the external display for the
  few seconds before the plugin notices the dock.
- The "another plugin is driving the same SDR setting" warning now appears only while that plugin is
  actually writing and fades once it stops. It also no longer prevents the plugin from restoring an SDR value
  gamescope dropped.
- Switching an effect off restores the right previous value after a lost reply, a brief disconnect, a
  return from an external display or another tool's color table.
- A change whose confirmation was lost is still undone; before, the boost could stay on.
- After gamescope restarts, the value another tool set on the new session is the one restored.
- Switching an HDR or SDR look on while the display server is slow to answer no longer forgets another
  tool's color table.
- The panel is judged the way gamescope judges it: an EDID without color data counts as a standard
  (Rec.709) panel with D65 white, and odd red values are taken as they are.
- On sessions where gamescope does not publish its EDID path, the built-in panel's EDID is read from the
  kernel. A standard-gamut panel whose information cannot be read for a moment keeps its own mapping.
- The items above used to put a standard screen on the wide-gamut mapping, where every setting is much
  stronger.
- Docking is read from the display server that reports it. Lasting errors are logged once rather than on
  every retry, and in Desktop Mode the plugin no longer logs every X server every few seconds while it waits for
  gamescope.

**SDR**
- 100% writes gamescope's own default, which is neutral on every panel, so it stays neutral even when the
  panel could not be identified.

**HDR**
- 100% no longer briefly shows **building the LUT...** for a table it never builds.

**Updates**
- A successful download clears the error of an earlier failed attempt, and checking again, or a check
  that fails, keeps a finished download of the same release.

### 🐛 Fixed

**Settings**
- Saved settings are protected when the plugin cannot read them or Decky stops during startup.
  Controls now wait for settings to load instead of replacing your choices with defaults.
- Startup and display checks no longer get stuck on invalid settings or display-information files.

**Errors**
- Startup errors now explain what failed. A settings-file problem is no longer described as a missing
  Game Mode connection or a failed save.

**Menu**
- Slow or missing backend replies no longer let repeated status checks build up a queue of requests.
- Status checking resumes when the pending call finishes, keeping newer choices made after reopening the
  menu or using **Back to defaults**.

**Updates**
- Update checks and downloads keep their progress when you close and reopen the Quick Access Menu.
  Completed download paths and errors remain available.
- Reopening the menu no longer starts duplicate update requests, buttons from a closed menu cannot start
  another operation, and the installed version is reused instead of fetched again each time.

### 🔧 Changed

**Performance**
- Much faster controls on Armada devices running Decky through emulation. On Odin 3, saturation
  changes took about 0.6 seconds for HDR and 0.7 seconds for SDR, and turning an effect off during a build took
  41–121 ms. Results may vary by device and workload; ordinary SteamOS keeps its existing execution path.
- Faster color-LUT generation, and recent results are reused when you return to a previous
  saturation value. LUT resolution and color calculations are unchanged.
- Fewer repeated display checks, unnecessary saves and rebuilds, leaving more room for the controls
  to respond to your next change.

**Errors**
- Connection problems and failed changes are shown more clearly, and the plugin retries operations that
  could not be completed.

**Display**
- Better recovery after sleep, temporary display connection problems and changes between the built-in
  screen and an external monitor.
- Better detection of the panel's color capabilities and HDR support.

**Updates**
- Better update detection, including preview versions, and more reliable downloads on slow connections.
- Stricter checks of update files; failed downloads or packaging attempts keep the previous usable file.

### 🐛 Fixed

**Menu**
- The "Backend unavailable - python exception" message that could prevent the plugin menu from working.

**Sliders**
- Sliders keep your latest selection instead of jumping back to an older value, and closing and
  reopening the menu no longer brings back outdated changes.
- Rapid slider moves and repeated toggles no longer create a long queue of work. Turning an effect off
  or resetting settings cancels changes you no longer want.

**Settings**
- Settings are saved more reliably, including when Decky stops during startup. Slow or failed saves no
  longer hold up the controls or prevent a reset.

**Display**
- Disabling the plugin restores the previous display settings more reliably, including when another tool
  has changed them while the plugin was active.
- Returning saturation to neutral no longer leaves an older color effect active.

**Updates**
- Download folders and filenames containing special characters are handled correctly.

### 🔧 Changed
- **HDR:** the status shows the saturation of the last LUT successfully sent, without claiming gamescope has
  confirmed loading it.

### 🐛 Fixed

**Display**
- Failed HDR and SDR look builds or replacements are retried. An older working file no longer counts as
  a completed slider change.

**Errors**
- SDR, SDR look and HDR errors are kept independently. A successful operation on one control no longer
  hides another control's failed apply or reset.

**SDR**
- Enabling again after a failed release preserves the original baseline instead of capturing the plugin's
  own value.
- Missing SDR properties and failed initial SDR writes are retried. A missing property is recreated only
  after confirming gamescope is still reachable.
- The standard-gamut SDR look above 200% now converts gamescope's generic source gamut to BT.2020 for ICtCp
  and back before clipping. Native white from EDID is adapted to D65; unreadable white falls back to D65.

**Sliders**
- Pending edits remain visible, and outdated status responses cannot overwrite newer slider values.
